display: Inspect the current project folder and its existing website files. Identify my wedding customization and budget calculator pages. Check for missing files, broken links and Git conflicts. Do not modify, delete, rename or move any files yet. Only report your findings.

Build my three assigned web pages for our FAST-NUCES AICT final project, a wedding planning website called "Petal & Promise".

Student details

- Name: M.Yousuf
- Roll number: 26i-3179
- Section: D
- Responsibility: Wedding Customization and Budget Planning

Technical requirements

Use HTML5, CSS3 and vanilla JavaScript only. Do not use React, external JavaScript frameworks or backend services.

Inspect the current workspace and active branch before starting. Do not overwrite, delete or modify my teammates' files. Work exclusively inside the following three folders:

- Yousuf1
- Yousuf2
- Yousuf3

Each folder should contain index.html, css/style.css, js/app.js and an images folder where necessary. Use these exact folder names consistently, including capitalization.

Design requirements

Create a premium, elegant, romantic wedding planning experience with floral decorations, attractive cards, smooth transitions, rounded corners and consistent navigation.

Use the following shared colour palette:

- Ivory: #FFF9F5
- Blush pink: #F3D7DF
- Dusty rose: #D49AA8
- Sage green: #A3AC96
- Mocha: #554A45

Use roses, lilies and subtle floral SVG decorations. Make the website visually rich without excessive clutter. All three pages should share the same typography, navigation, footer and design language.

Page 1 — Wedding Customization (Yousuf1)

Create an interactive wedding customization page.

Allow users to select their preferred wedding style:

- Eastern
- Western
- Fusion

Display attractive visual cards for each wedding style with descriptions.

Allow users to select multiple wedding ceremonies:

- Nikkah
- Mehndi
- Baraat
- Walima
- Reception

Dynamically display the selected wedding style, selected ceremonies and total number of events.

Require users to select a wedding style and at least one ceremony before proceeding.

Save the selections in localStorage under the key "wedding".

Add a Continue to Budget Planning button that opens Yousuf2/index.html.

Page 2 — Wedding Budget Calculator (Yousuf2)

Create a fully functional wedding budget calculator.

Retrieve and display the wedding style and ceremonies selected on Page 1.

Include inputs for:

- Total wedding budget in PKR
- Number of guests
- Spending priority: Balanced, Catering, Venue, Decoration or Photography

Validate all inputs. Reject empty fields, negative budgets, zero guests and fractional guest counts.

Calculate the total budget per guest.

Automatically distribute the budget across:

- Catering
- Venue
- Decoration
- Photography
- Emergency reserve

For balanced spending, use 40%, 25%, 15%, 10% and 10% respectively. Adjust the percentages logically according to the selected spending priority while ensuring the total remains 100%.

Display calculated results dynamically with formatted PKR amounts and visual progress bars.

Save the budget information in localStorage under the key "budget".

Include Reset, Back and Continue to Budget Breakdown buttons.

Page 3 — Budget Breakdown and Saved Plan (Yousuf3)

Create a detailed wedding budget dashboard using information saved from the previous two pages.

Display:

- Selected wedding style
- Selected ceremonies
- Total events
- Number of guests
- Total wedding budget
- Budget per guest
- Spending priority
- Category-wise budget allocation

Create an attractive interactive budget visualization using CSS, SVG or HTML Canvas without external libraries.

Allow users to edit individual budget allocations.

Automatically calculate total allocated funds and remaining budget.

Display a warning when allocations exceed the total budget.

Include functionality to:

- Save the final wedding plan
- Edit the previous selections
- Reset the wedding plan with confirmation
- Print the wedding budget summary
- Download the wedding budget summary as a text file

Save the final plan in localStorage under the key "weddingPlan".

Ensure saved information remains available after refreshing the browser.

Navigation and integration

Connect all three pages through working relative links. Ensure folder names and capitalization match exactly for GitHub Pages compatibility.

Do not create unnecessary companion HTML pages. These three index.html files are my three assigned website pages.

Do not overwrite the repository's main index.html, shared README or other members' folders.

Accessibility and responsiveness

Ensure all pages work on desktop and mobile screens.

Use semantic HTML, accessible form labels, keyboard navigation, readable colour contrast, image alt text and clear validation messages.

Verification

After implementation, test the following scenario:

Wedding style: Eastern
Ceremonies: Nikkah, Mehndi and Walima
Budget: PKR 1,500,000
Guests: 200
Priority: Balanced

Expected results:

- Total ceremonies: 3
- Budget per guest: PKR 7,500
- Catering: PKR 600,000
- Venue: PKR 375,000
- Decoration: PKR 225,000
- Photography: PKR 150,000
- Emergency reserve: PKR 150,000
- Remaining budget: PKR 0

Test invalid inputs, navigation, localStorage persistence, mobile responsiveness and budget editing.

Create a personal README.md documenting my three pages, features, implementation and actual test results.

Credit the contribution to M.Yousuf (26i-3179).

Retain the genuine Antigravity CLI session history. Do not fabricate testing results, feedback, session logs or Git commits.

Do not automatically commit, push or merge anything. Report the completed files, actual tests performed and any remaining issues when finished.

Begin implementation now.
